flags.why: This adjective describes a large body or body part, so applying it to a pot teaches an inappropriate use ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/cộ)).
flags.fix: Thân hình anh ấy to cộ. = He has a huge build.

flags.why: Kiêu xa means arrogant and extravagant; the flattering description given belongs to kiêu sa ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kiêu_xa)).
The example uses kiêu xa as a compliment about beauty, confusing it with kiêu sa ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kiêu_xa)).
flags.fix: Thói kiêu xa của hắn khiến mọi người khó chịu. = His arrogance and extravagance annoy everyone.

flags.why: The actual meaning of kiêu xa is dated and should not be presented as ordinary current usage ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kiêu_xa)).
